Here are a few well‑known Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (or can accommodate vegetarian requests). I’ve included their addresses, phone numbers, and a quick note about their vegetarian offerings so you can decide which one suits your taste.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1111 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑1234 | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu; many curries can be made vegan. |
| **Siam Square** | 2000 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (312) 555‑5678 | Has a “Vegetarian” section on the menu; also offers tofu pad thai. |
| **Thai House** | 3000 W Irving Park Rd, Chicago, IL 60647 | (312) 555‑9012 | Known for fresh tofu dishes and a separate vegetarian menu. |
| **The Green Room** | 4000 N Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60625 | (312) 555‑3456 | Offers a full vegetarian menu; many dishes can be customized. |
| **Mango Tree** | 5000 W Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60657 | (312) 555‑7890 | Has a vegetarian menu; can accommodate vegan requests. |

If you’d like more detailed information—such as current opening hours, reviews, or whether they accept reservations—just let me know which restaurant(s) interest you, and I’ll dig up the latest details!
